references.text: The same introductory formula 'The Lord spoke to Moses and said' is used repeatedly in the books of Moses to introduce divine commands.
An identical introductory formula at the beginning of Leviticus, showing the pattern of how God communicates His commands to Moses.
Numbers begins with the same formula, establishing Moses as the recipient of God's word and mediator to the people.
Close preceding context with the same introductory formula introducing instructions about Israel's camp.
The Lord speaks to Moses on Mount Sinai, the same communication pattern between God and Moses.
